fix(observe): finalize launcher-keyed telemetry shards at SessionEnd (bug-98f32723)

SessionEnd passed the Claude session id to finalize.Session, but the
launcher keys the telemetry directory by its own OTel id, so finalize found
no events.ndjson and did nothing. It also materialized rollups under the
directory name, while signals carry the harness session ids.

- ShardsFor resolves shards from WIPNOTE_OTEL_SESSION_ID (the launcher id
  that session-start already uses for the rosetta event) plus the harness
  id's own directory.
- Session now rolls up every session_id found in the shard, so catch-up
  also produces cost data for launcher-keyed shards.

Refs: bug-98f32723

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_014ScSDSxU4AZ7bK1dAVHM8g

git rev-parse --short HEAD && git push -q -u origin fix/finalize-launcher-session-id 2>&1 | tail -2
gh pr create --base main --title "fix(observe): finalize launcher-keyed telemetry shards at SessionEnd (bug-98f32723)" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
Fixes bug-98f32723 (caused by bug-bb96a980).

**Root cause.** The SessionEnd hook passed the Claude session id to `finalize.Session`. `wipnote claude` keys the telemetry directory by the launcher's OTel id (`WIPNOTE_OTEL_SESSION_ID`), so `sessions/<claude-id>/events.ndjson` did not exist and finalize returned nil. Separately, `Session` rolled up only the directory name, but signals carry harness ids, so a launcher-keyed shard produced no rollup even when finalized (including by catch-up).

**Fix.**
- `finalize.ShardsFor` resolves shards from `WIPNOTE_OTEL_SESSION_ID` (the existing launcher id) plus the harness id's own directory. `finalizeSessionTelemetry` finalizes each within the existing budget (Codex 900ms, other 10s).
- `finalize.Session` rolls up every `session_id` found in the shard, not just the directory name.

**Tests.** Launcher-keyed shard with a Claude id passed to the hook, catch-up on a launcher shard, `ShardsFor` cases. They fail without the fix.

**Follow-ups.** A 4.2 MB shard takes about 10s to replay, so it can miss the 10s SessionEnd budget and always exceeds the 2s SessionStart catch-up budget; the 2-minute daemon/prune catch-up covers it. `signalCollector` also looks for `.collector-pid` under the Claude id.
